cohort: 250 patients (125 in each group: interpregnancy interval 6-12 months vs. >12 months) at the departments of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Punjab Rangers Teaching Hospital Lahore
finding: Short interpregnancy intervals (6-12 months) were significantly associated with low birth weight.
birth_weight: low birth weight (defined as <2500g, exact threshold not specified in abstract)
